name: Geoff Layton
headline: NetSuite Consultant and Manager | Oracle ERP | CPA | Architect | Proj Mgr
about:
I've successfully delivered mission-critical NetSuite and Oracle ERP systems over a number of years. My solutions are both resilient and flexible, designed to stand the test of time. I've led the deployment of these crucial systems for billion-dollar enterprises and companies of all sizes worldwide. I understand the absolute importance of ensuring that ERP systems work flawlessly, as any downtime or suboptimal performance is not an option.
I have made significant contributions to successful ERP projects at major global customers including Sherwin-Williams, Canon, Toshiba, ResMed, Boral, Dana, Alcoa, Rio Tinto, DHL, Telstra, Cochlear, British Telecom, Kellogg's, Royal & Sun Alliance and Vodafone. And, to outperform rivals in today's competitive landscape, your ERP system must excel. That's why I've distilled essential best practices and innovations to enhance the NetSuite and Oracle ERP Platforms, which I believe are the leaders in 21st-century ERP solutions.
Summary of my skillset:★ Focused on key pillars of Strategy, Process, Technology and People★ Oracle Netsuite and ERP Expert - Financials-Supply Chain-Manufacturing★ Collaborative approach to Consulting, Project Management and Business Analysis★ Demonstrated accomplishments across multiple industries and geographies★ Agile Software Design, Development and Implementation

experiences.companyName: Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand
experiences.description: One of Australia’s most sophisticated NetSuite sites with > 400 users.  Top service tier and high-end features.  Advanced Revenue Management.  Subscription processing. SuiteCloud Plus. SuiteCommerce Advanced.  Analytics Warehouse.  StrongPoint. Adaptive Insights. Integrated with SalesForce and many other platforms via Boomi.  Both B2B and B2C processes.

I implemented Oracle Netsuite successfully at a number of clients in Financial Services, Hospitality, Wholesale Distribution, Retail and Manufacturing.  This included some of the first Netsuite Warehouse Management (WMS) implementations in Australia.
I made important contributions to the growth of the firm through the winning of new and repeat business.   The firm was awarded Highest Growth Partner by Netsuite after my first year with the company.

Working for Deloitte significantly strengthened my skills in Management Consulting and Project Management, while at the same time continued to build my Oracle E-Business skills (particularly in the Financials area of the suite).  I completed the Deloitte Consulting Curriculum and made important contributions to Deloitte Oracle Applications implementations in the Asia-Pacific region.  I also worked on several non-Oracle management consulting engagements.

I was an Oracle Applications consultant working as a direct employee of Oracle Corporation, and consulted to Australian companies who were implementing Oracle Applications.  This experience helped me to develop key skills in the areas of software and technology.

I held various positions at Comalco Aluminium (which is now part of a merged entity, Rio Tinto Alcan), including Management Accountant and Business Analyst.  These roles gave me a very good foundation in Manufacturing and Distribution.
